note: manual curated naming from 65-filtered real candidates (312 sub_ callers>=1 sweep, noise-filtered via >=4 real insns; excludes 0x0205+/0x0207+/0x020f+ data zones): halfword flag/mode setters, null-guarded field writers, alternating/multiword fills, two-input classifier, 2D matrix fill, fixed-point normalize, struct range validator, intrusive-list head init/push-back/walk-clear, signed coord bounds, ARM7 byte-array scan + cmd-send wrapper. verified via disasm-arm9/arm7-full.txt

names.name: halfword_mode_bits_set
names.comment: call 0x2008630 then clear-low-2-bits + set bit0 on two halfword regs (ldrh, bic #3, orr #1, strh) — mode register pair update

names.name: halfword_flag_bits_check
names.comment: read halfwords [r1,#2] and [r1,#6], ands #0x20/#0x10 on each, bne to 0x2024d08 on any set — dual-field status flag gate

names.name: list_stride44_walk
names.comment: walk list from r0 with count r3 (ble exit), stride +0x44 per element, r8=head idx, [sb,#4] null-check toggles stride — batch processing loop

names.name: guarded_field_triple_halfword_write
names.comment: null-guard [r0] then write 3 halfwords: [obj,#0x34]=2, [obj,#0x38]=r1, [obj,#0x3a]=r2 (bxeq lr when obj null)

names.name: guarded_field_pair_halfword_write
names.comment: null-guard [r0] then write 2 halfwords: [obj,#0x34]=1, [obj,#0x38]=r1 (strhne under cmp, bx lr when null)

names.name: alternating_word_fill_0x1000
names.comment: stm fill alternating 0x1000/0 pairs: [r0,#0x20]=0x1000 then stm r0!,{r2,r3}/stm r0!,{r1,r3} repeat — periodic struct init

names.name: signed_halfword_store_signbit
names.comment: signed 16-bit store: r1==0->store 0; r1>0->orr #0x4000; r1<0->negate + orr #0x8000, strh to [r0] — sign+value packed halfword

names.name: multiword_zero_clear_16
names.comment: mov r1/r2/r3/ip=0 then 10x stm r0,{r1,r2,r3,ip} (40 regs but no writeback = repeat same 16 words) — 64-byte object zero clear

names.name: two_input_classifier
names.comment: dispatch on (r0,r1) pairs: (0,0)->7, (0,1)->6, (1,1)->4, others->b 0x203ed18 fallthrough — enum classification selector

names.name: matrix_fill_loop_2d
names.comment: 2D nested fill: str r2,[r7,r8,lsl#2] inner loop (r8 vs fp blt), outer r6 vs [sp,#4] blt with row stride add — word matrix store

names.name: fixed_point_normalize_store
names.comment: fixed-point normalize: halfword [r3,sb] delta -> abs (rsbmi), rsb 0x8000, asr #6 + lsr #25 rounding, asr #7, str [base,r6,lsl#2] — div-by-128 with sign fold

names.name: struct_field_range_validator
names.comment: validate struct: [r0,#4]<=0x70, [r0,#0x18] in [0xa,0x3e8] (blo/bls), [r0,#0x32]>=1, else return 0 — bounds-checked object validator

names.name: intrusive_list_walk_clear_fields
names.comment: walk global list from [pc] ptr: for each node set [ip,#0x64]=r2, clear [ip,#0x78]/[ip,#0x7c]/[ip,#0x80], next=[ip,#0x80] until null

names.name: intrusive_list_head_init
names.comment: init list head at r0: [r0]=[r0,#4]=self (ldr/str loop), [r0,#8]=[r0,#0xc]=self, then store r1->[r0,#0x10], r2->[r0,#0x14], clear #0x18/#0x1c — self-referential head

names.name: intrusive_list_push_back
names.comment: push r1 into list at r0: tail=[r0,#0x70]; empty->head@[r0,#0x6c]=r1 else link tail next@+0x10/prev@+0x14; [r1,#0x10]=0, [r0,#0x70]=r1

names.name: signed_coord_delta_bounds_check
names.comment: compare r1-[r0,#0xc] and r2-(signed halfword [r0,#0x10]): negative delta or non-zero equal -> return 0; else signed add adjust and continue

names.name: arm7_byte_array_has_nonzero
names.comment: scan byte array: count=[r0,#0xa] must be in (0,0x20]; walk bytes at [r0+#0xc], return 1 on first non-zero else 0

names.name: arm7_alloc_init_free_wrapper
names.comment: r0->alloc via 0x33a6374 (save r4), load global [r1,#0x544]/[r1,#0x548], call 0x33a53dc(hi,lo,r0), then release via 0x33a6388 — alloc/init/free trip

names.name: arm7_cmd_send_0x86
names.comment: write 0x8000 via 0x33a6bd0 then call 0x239f164(0x86, 0x20, r0, 4) — fixed command 0x86 + param 0x20 dispatch wrapper
